method: Each motif group was labelled by eye from the rendered contact sheets artifacts/ptn/sheet_<pair>_left_S1.png (one cell per group, showing the group's representative shape, its instance count, its size in PDF points and the shape class of its nearest text). Labels are the author's visual judgement, not derived from any measured feature.

classes.SYMBOL: a recognisable engineering symbol or annotation object (axis/marking bubble, leader with bubble, dimension arrow, window, camera, crossed-square switch, terminal circle)
classes.HATCH: hatch / fill linework: parallel or crossing short strokes, or a hatch fill inside a contour
classes.RECT: a plain rectangle whose semantics cannot be read from the shape (frame, text mask, legend cell, table cell)
classes.OTHER: line fragments, degenerate zero-size motifs, connectors
